event.selection_basis: PG&E's amended CPUC-filed post-event report says the first circuit was de-energized at 2019-10-09 00:09 PDT, lists Napa among the first-phase counties, and describes a forecast offshore-wind event. This is planned de-energization evidence only.
exclusions: No matched EAGLE-I county-time-series receipt has been collected.
uncertainties: The 00:09 PDT start is the report's first circuit system-wide, not a Napa-specific circuit activation time.
The report's PG&E/CPUC account is not independent verification of wildfire causation or a county outage label.
Reported wind-related damage/hazards are retained separately from this planned-PSPS candidate and are not represented as fire occurrence or verified wildfire damage.
